localChanges: When something goes wrong inside the game, a window now says so, instead of the game sitting on "waiting" with no way to tell a problem from a slow turn (#470).
A report or list that could not be worked out, such as Top Cities or a city's production choices, no longer stops that window from ever opening again until the page is reloaded (#470).
An order that runs into a problem no longer ends your turn without a word: you are told, and your turn carries on (#470).
A save that cannot be loaded now says why and takes you back to the main menu, instead of leaving a blank page (#470).
